chain_words.nuance: close to the true value but not exact
correct, matching the true value or fact
identical to the true value in every respect
so correct that no error at all can be found

explanation: These words all describe how closely a result matches the truth, from a rough estimate to a result with no error.

usage_notes.difference: 'Precise' refers to fine detail and careful measurement; 'exact' means completely identical to the true value or specification.
